entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I... I think I need to make a return? I have this helmet and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To start, can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Mark Peterson. The order number is... uh... VF88-2190. I just don't know what to do. The website was a bit overwhelming.

Thank you, Mark. I've pulled up your order for the Trail Helmet. I see it was delivered nine days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. It's just... the color. It looked different online. It doesn't match my bike at all, and I feel a bit silly about it. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Mark. I completely understand wanting to get the color just right. It's an important part of your gear. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Since you received the helmet just nine days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much! I was worried I'd be stuck with it. Getting the right gear is so important for safety, you know? I want to make sure I'm happy with it.

I agree completely, your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you!
You're very welcome, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
